content.hebrew: קהל:וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ: (ישעיהו מ:יח)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’el mi tedammeyun El uma demut ta‘arkhu lo:
content.english: Cong.And to whom could you compare God; and what comparison could you make to Him? (Isa. 40:18)

content.hebrew: קהל:לְמִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְתַשְׁו֑וּ וְתַמְשִׁל֖וּנִי וְנִדְמֶֽה: (ישעיהו מו:ה)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Lemi tedammeyuni vetashvu vetamshiluni venidmeh:
content.english: Cong.To whom could you compare Me, and declare Me similar; or liken Me, such that we could be compared? (Isa. 46:5)

content.hebrew: קהל:וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ: (ישעיהו מ:כה)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’el mi tedammeyuni ve’eshvē yomar Ḳadosh:
content.english: Cong.And to whom could you compare Me, that I would be similar to them—says the holy One. (Isa. 40:25)
Says the Lord of lords,
Who removes the veil from the mind’s eye,
The one great in deed, and the secrets of whose law are concealed:

content.hebrew: נֵרוֹת מְנוֹרָה יָאִֽירוּ לְמוּל שֻׁלְחַן הַפָּנִים.
content.transliteration: Nerot menorah ya’iru lemul shulkhan happanim.
content.english: The Menorah’s lamps should give light, facing the Table of Showing.
content.comments: Table of Showing. Where the Showbread is placed.

content.hebrew: לְוִיִּם יִטָּהֲרוּ, וְיִהְיוּ לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו נְתוּנִים,
content.transliteration: Leviyyim yittaharu, veyihyu le’Aharon ulvanav netunim,
content.english: The Levites should purify themselves, and be given to Aaron and his sons;

content.hebrew: מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים עַד חֲמִשִּׁים, לַעֲבֹד יִהְיוּ מְמֻנִּים;
content.transliteration: Mibben ḥamesh ve‘esrim ‘ad ben ḥamish’shim, la‘avod yihyu memunnim;
content.english: They should be appointed to work from age twenty-five to fifty,

content.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי כֵן בְּבֵית יוי שָׁרִים וְנוֹגְנִים.
content.transliteration: Aḥarē khen bevet Adonai sharim venoḡenim.
content.english: After which they should sing and make music in Adonai’s house.

content.hebrew: חֶֽסֶד אֵל פָּרוּשׂ לְעַמּוֹ – סְכָכָם בַּעֲנָנִים;
content.transliteration: Ḥesed El parus le‘ammo – sekhakham ba‘ananim;
content.english: God’s mercy is spread out over His people—He sheltered them in clouds;

content.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יוי נֹסְעִים, וְעַל־פִּי יוי חֹנִים.
content.transliteration: ‘al pi Adonai nose‘im, ve‘al pi Adonai ḥonim.
content.english: They would travel at Adonai’s command, and camp at Adonai’s command.
And when the Ark would travel Moses would say, in song:
“Rise up, Adonai, and may the enemies and foes be scattered!”

content.hebrew: וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר: "שׁוּבָה יוי רִבְבוֹת מַמְלֶֽכֶת כֹּהֲנִים!"
content.transliteration: Uvnuḥo yomar: “Shuva Adonai riv’vot mamlekhet kohanim!”
content.english: And when it would rest, he would say: “Return, Adonai, [among] the myriads of the Kingdom of Priests.”
content.comments: Kingdom of Priests. The Israelite nation.

content.english: A fire consumed the people who were complaining.
And when God’s prophet, the head of all believers, saw
That human thoughts were [occupied with] lugubrious cravings and imaginings,
He asked God for leaders to be appointed,
And was told to gather seventy elders.
[God] graciously gave them of his splendor—pleasurable splendor.
He, indeed,  makes peace on high.
He, indeed,  also supervises [the earth] down below.
He, indeed,  [has done so] for the earlier [generations], and also for the later [ones].

content.hebrew: קהל: הַכֹּל יוֹדֽוּהוּ וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחֽוּהוּ וְהַכֹּל לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ עוֹנִים:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Hakkol yoduhu vehakkol yeshabbeḥuhu vehakkol lehaḳdisho ‘onim:
content.english: Cong. All acknowledge Him, and all praise Him, and all raise their voices to declare His holiness:

content.hebrew: חזן: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: en ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: Cantor. There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
